name: Parallel Volume Ray Casting (PVR) Library Interface
aliases: Direct Volume Rendering for Parallel CFD
definition: A library interface for distributed memory message passing environments that handles volume data on rectilinear grids, allowing application programs to pass subvolume pointers, geometry records, and rendering specifications.
summary: The Parallel Volume Ray Casting Library Interface enables in-place distributed volume rendering by separating local resampling from global direct compositing, avoiding binary-swap dependencies and regular data partitioning requirements.
